description: Update workspace identity: name, industry and subIndustry (values from the dashboard's industry list; a new industry without a subIndustry clears the old one), productDescription, authors (EEAT bylines used in article JSON-LD), styleReferenceUrls (articles whose writing style the writer imitates), brandAliases (other spellings and short forms of the brand; pages using them count as brand mentions) and brandExclusions (same-name companies or products whose pages are skipped). Every array REPLACES the stored list — call get_brand first and send the full updated list. Saving a name change runs the brand-mention search once a day at most. websiteUrl is immutable and cannot be changed.

authors.description: Article bylines. Replaces the stored list.

linkedinUrl.description: Person sameAs URL for article JSON-LD

brandAliases.description: Other spellings and short forms of your brand name. Replaces the stored list.

brandExclusions.description: Same-name companies or products to leave out of brand mentions. Replaces the stored list.

industry.description: Your industry, from the dashboard's list

productDescription.description: What you sell, in a sentence or two

styleReferenceUrls.description: Articles whose writing style your articles follow. Replaces the stored list.

subIndustry.description: Specialty within the industry, from the same list

name: update_brand_identity
